Welcome to the 10th edition of Weekly Tidbits by Markets by Zerodha, where we bring you interesting stories that may not make it to a full Daily Brief but still deserve a closer look.
In this edition, we cover 12 stories across Global, Economy, Industry and Company (GEIC), from SpaceX's plans to build a mobile network and cyberattacks on supermarket fridges to foreign investors returning to Indian stocks and Adani's plans to expand its data centre business.
G — Global
E — Economy
I — Industry
